item: Review findings of #1306, #1298 and #1308 fixed, and a light memory snapshot every 15 s near the guard's line
key_paths: src/api/unlock.py; src/scheduler/storage_guard.py; src/database/pool_watch.py; src/monitoring/session_hwm.py; src/monitoring/forensics.py; src/api/insights.py; tests/test_session_hwm_light.py; tests/test_storage_guard.py; tests/test_unlock_recovery_progress.py
summary: A queued second unlock re-asks the state inside the lock (no second verify, engine dispose or upkeep on an open app); is_disk_full classifies on the head of the text and the detail kept is the driver's first line, never the statement or its bound values; a reading older than a minute is not used to classify an I/O error while another read is in flight; the guard's failure key is per path; wording of the three PRs corrected (eleven tests in four files, split two and nine by measurement). New: a light pressure snapshot every 15 s while available memory is within 1.5 times the guard's floor, the process near its share, or the guard engaged (own ring of 8 and own file, the busiest threads by CPU since the previous one with stacks, blocks gained, its own cost; memory is not per thread, so the pairing is labelled an inference); the heavy cadence is unchanged. The pin report names each holder's pool and says a checkout pins the log only while a statement, an open cursor or an uncommitted write does (a read_snapshot checkout holds its snapshot); the light snapshot reads each thread's own kernel CPU clock by its kernel thread id (eight /proc reads cost 1.2-1.7 s under eight busy threads, the clock 0.01-0.12 ms; the pthread record is never used, because another thread's join can free it), records how many threads it asked and read and says when the platform cannot read them, and counts and warns once of a failing light snapshot; a driver's error code is trusted over its words; a second unlock with a wrong passphrase on an open app is refused and a failed finish, whatever it raises, is not answered "unlocked" and drops the keyed pool. Each item named has a test; the main ones were also run against a mutant of their code (the unlock re-ask and its key, head-only classification, the age bound, the per-path key, the member's whole-size bound and the previous ring's cut, the real guard-line reader, the isolation of a failing light snapshot). session_hwm.diagnostics_member(max_bytes) is the tail as one bundle member (this session's and the previous session's light snapshots, newest kept, the cut named, a note when the budget cannot hold it); it is not called at this head, the slot table of the single Diagnostics zip (R119) is planned with the button.
